defaults.setup: Create or materialize the referenced literal Run fixture beneath a real temporary project root.
defaults.action: Call create_run, inspect_run, or submit_candidate at the row's public dispatcher seam and inspect exact returned values and files.

rows.oracle: One create publishes immutable run.md, exact breakdown.yaml, and steps/ beneath one new Run ID; later live edits leave them unchanged.
Injected UTC time and cryptographic entropy produce the exact run-id literal and invalid identities fail contextual inspection.
Attempts begin at one, remain contiguous across statuses/contexts, and gaps, duplicates, and leading-zero identities invalidate inspection.
Valid stems bind exact node, attempt, and settled time; filename, mtime, and directory-order changes never alter identity or selection.
The literal Run Manifest matches its schema and exact bytes; every mutable or unknown field is rejected.
Every literal StepArtifact frontmatter satisfies its schema and contextual invariants; status/problem mismatches invalidate the Run.
Exactly four statuses commit as history and no transient or derived state is accepted as a StepArtifact status.
Accepted Executor metadata has only kind, name, and optional version; model/provider/credential and other unknown fields fail.
Workflow and predecessor references match exact declarations, same-Run successful identity, paths, pairing, and raw digests.
Succeeded Markdown, including zero bytes, is selected whole; non-success bodies never become Inputs and no content is inserted.
Contracted JSON publishes the reviewed compact RFC 8785 literal with no LF; missing, extra, or invalid sidecars fail exactly.
Literal LF/no-BOM frontmatter records pass and BOM, CRLF, missing-byte-zero frontmatter, and normalization attempts fail.
Current families pass, mixed or unknown families fail unsupported_version, and inspection performs no migration write.
Each indexed layout, identity, timestamp, digest, binding, pairing, status, and Data Contract corruption invalidates the Run.
All discoverable Run errors use only the named categories and sort by file, path, then code.
Temporary, orphan JSON, and unrelated entries are ignored while every normative Markdown commit marker is validated.
Every accepted Run Manifest and StepArtifact conforms to the published closed-world schemas without implementation-only fields.
The public literal record catalog contains every named valid record form and corruption/ignored-entry scenario with exact bytes.
